title: ModLocker
description: This datapack blocks gamemodes for all players.
body:
# ModLocker

## About this pack
This data pack allows you to "lock" the gamemode for all players on the server. Perfect for adventure maps, mini-games, or any server where you need full control over player permissions!
<details>
<summary>README</summary>

### Becoming an exception:
To exclude yourself from the gamemode lock (e.g. as an admin), run:

_/function gamemode:admin_tag_


### Locking a game mode:


_/function gamemode:survival_ **(Survival | default)**

_/function gamemode:adventure_ **(Adventure)**

_/function gamemode:spectator_ **(Spectator)**

_/function gamemode:creative_ **(Creative)**
</details>

### Note:
If you find any bugs, please report them in the **"#🪲report-bugs"** channel on our Discord server using the "ModLocker" tag!
